title: Submodules of finite modules over a two-variable polynomial ring are finite
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1]. If N is a finitely generated (ungraded) S-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and K is an S-submodule of N, then K is finitely generated as an S-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].

match: finite module over Noetherian ring is Noetherian, and every submodule is FG

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: `MvPolynomial.isNoetherianRing` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/Basic.lean:935, Hilbert basis, instance) makes S = MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k Noetherian; the instance `isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Basic.lean:324-328) makes the finite S-module N Noetherian; `IsNoetherian.noetherian` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Defs.lean:63-64) applied to K gives K.FG
